summary: Russia launched a massive combined strike on Kyiv region with 24 ballistic missiles, 4 Zircon hypersonic missiles, and 115 drones, resulting in 17 deaths and 44 injuries with zero missiles intercepted. Russian forces simultaneously liberated Ryzhevka in Sumy region and Zarnitsa in Zaporizhzhia region while intensifying attacks on civilian logistics infrastructure across Ukraine. Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 66 Shahed-type drones but 29 strike UAVs and one Oniks missile hit 18 locations during overnight attacks from multiple directions.
key_points: Russia struck Kyiv region with 24 ballistic missiles, 4 Zircons, and 115 drones; none intercepted, 17 killed, 44 injured, targeting civilian logistics. (Source: @UkraineNow/83208)
Overnight Russian attack included 2 Oniks, 2 Kh-31P, and 101 strike UAVs; 66 intercepted but 29 UAVs and one Oniks hit 18 locations. (Source: @kpszsu/71719)
Russian presidential advisor states Russia can launch ~100 ballistic missiles monthly, using reserves, and will intensify strikes on logistics to create shortages. (Source: @UkraineNow/83228)
Russian MoD claims liberation of Ryzhevka (Sumy) and Zarnitsa (Zaporizhzhia) settlements. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32213)

Critical logistics infrastructure destroyed: Wildberries hub in Olexin, 90% of Epicenter warehouse in Kyiv, Rozetka's largest warehouse in Brovary (100k orders/day), BookChef lost 10M books. (Source: @eRadarrua/104149, @ukr_leaks_eng/32222, @ukr_leaks_eng/32206, @UkraineNow/83232)

Zelensky outlines three winter priorities: critical infrastructure protection, shelter availability, anti-ballistic capabilities; military to target Russian ballistic launchers. (Source: @UkraineNow/83230)
Swedish Supreme Court orders transfer of Russian shadow fleet vessel Caffa to Ukraine; used for illegal grain export from occupied Sevastopol. (Source: @UkraineNow/83234)
Zelensky reports Western air defense missile supplies decreased threefold despite partners having missiles. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32220)

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a massive combined strike on Kyiv region with 24 ballistic missiles, 4 Zircon hypersonic missiles, and 115 drones, resulting in 17 deaths and 44 injuries with zero missiles intercepted. Russian forces simultaneously liberated Ryzhevka in Sumy region and Zarnitsa in Zaporizhzhia region while intensifying attacks on civilian logistics infrastructure across Ukraine. points: Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 66 enemy UAVs (Shahed, Gerbera, Italmas, parody types) overnight but 29 strike UAVs and one Oniks missile hit 18 locations with debris falling at 5 additional sites. (Source: @kpszsu/71719)

President Zelensky defined three winter priorities: strengthening critical infrastructure protection, ensuring sufficient shelters and bomb shelters, and increasing anti-ballistic capabilities including destroying Russian ballistic launchers. (Source: @UkraineNow/83230)

Government urgently organized meetings with business representatives after massive attacks; Ministry of Economy tasked with ensuring uninterrupted logistics and trade operations in response to Russian missile terror on civilian enterprises. (Source: @UkraineNow/83211)

Ukraine to receive €1.4 billion from frozen Russian asset revenues for defense strengthening and state resilience; PM Koretsky stated response to Russian terror must be strengthening Ukraine. (Source: @UkraineNow/83215)

Swedish Supreme Court decided to transfer Russian shadow fleet vessel Caffa to Ukraine; Ukrainian investigation confirms vessel used for illegal grain export from occupied Sevastopol. (Source: @UkraineNow/83234)

Zelensky complained Western air defense missile supplies decreased threefold while partners retain missiles; Ukraine negotiating Patriot license production with options including Ukrainian component manufacturing and PAC-3 production. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32220, @UkraineNow/83222)
Forcible evacuation of children from Kramatorsk and neighboring villages in the part of DPR still under Kyiv control; residents forced to leave homes. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32223)

Russian forces launched massive strike on Kyiv region with 24 ballistic missiles, 4 Zircon hypersonic missiles, and 115 drones; zero missiles intercepted, 17 killed, 44 injured, targeting warehouses, railway station, brewery, construction materials, and civilian logistics. (Source: @UkraineNow/83208)
Russian MoD claims liberation of Ryzhevka settlement in Sumy region and Zarnitsa settlement in Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32213)

Russia capable of launching approximately 100 ballistic missiles monthly, partially from reserves, and will intensify strikes on Ukrainian logistics and warehouses to create goods shortages. (Source: @UkraineNow/83228, @ukr_leaks_eng/32217)
Russian forces continued strikes on sea vessels involved in Ukrainian Armed Forces interests on evening of August 5 per Russian MoD. (Source: @tass_agency/388943)
Russian FPV drone attacked ATB truck during food delivery to supermarket in Kherson; vehicle completely burned, fire extinguished, no casualties reported. (Source: @UkraineNow/83213)
Russian 'banderol' glide bomb strike on civilian enterprise in Kharkiv's Novobavarsky district injured 8 people. (Source: @UkraineNow/83213)
Russian FPV drone attack on bus transporting workers in Komyshany injured 6 people. (Source: @UkraineNow/83239)

Russian strikes destroyed Wildberries logistics hub in Olexin completely; 90% of Epicenter logistics warehouse in Kyiv region destroyed containing food and household chemicals; Rozetka's largest warehouse in Brovary (100k orders/day) destroyed and unrestorable; BookChef publishing lost 100k books in reserve warehouse strike, total ~10M books destroyed since July. (Source: @eRadarrua/104149, @ukr_leaks_eng/32222, @ukr_leaks_eng/32206, @UkraineNow/83232)
Russian KAB guided aerial bombs employed on Donetsk region with course toward eastern Dnipropetrovsk region. (Source: @kpszsu/71720)
Russian KAB strikes reported on Zaporizhzhia and Dnipropetrovsk regions. (Source: @kpszsu/71696)
Group of reactive UAVs attacked Zaporizhzhia from southeast direction. (Source: @kpszsu/71691)
Reactive UAV from Zaporizhzhia region headed to Dnipropetrovsk region on course to Pokrov and Kryvyi Rih. (Source: @kpszsu/71705)
Zaporizhzhia city area: reactive UAV over city, another reactive UAV north of Komyshuha maneuvering on easterly course. (Source: @eRadarrua/104229)
Russian forces liberated Zarnitsa settlement in Zaporizhzhia region per MoD claim. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32213)
Dnipropetrovsk region: reconnaissance unit 1 and reactive UAV group 1 detected. (Source: @eRadarrua/104172)
Group of reactive UAVs from Belgorod region, RF, headed to southern Sumy region on course to Okhtyrka. (Source: @kpszsu/71695)

Group of reactive UAVs from Sumy region headed to Chernihiv region on course to Sribne and Pryluky; reactive UAV in central Sumy region on course to Romny; reactive UAVs from Kursk region, RF, on course to Sumy. (Source: @kpszsu/71714, @kpszsu/71693)
UAV detected over Sumy area moving toward Mykolaivka; Poltava region: Zavodske area mentioned. (Source: @eRadarrua/104228)
Ballistic missile threat reported from northeast direction; 2 ballistic missiles targeted Brovary; missile threat on Kyiv. (Source: @eRadarrua/104217, @mon1tor_ua/69814, @mon1tor_ua/69815)
Air raid alert declared in Kyiv at 01:28, cancelled at 01:45 on 06.08.2026. (Source: @eRadarrua/104216, @eRadarrua/104225)
Poltava region: UAV on course to Komishnya; Chernihiv region: 1 reactive UAV circling near Horodnia. (Source: @eRadarrua/104212)
Myronivka and Rzhyshchiv locations referenced in monitoring reports. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69819)
Russian FPV drone attacked ATB truck during food delivery to supermarket in Kherson; vehicle completely burned. (Source: @UkraineNow/83213)
UAV from Black Sea headed to Odesa region on course to Kurortne and Serhiivka. (Source: @kpszsu/71703)
Russian Oniks anti-ship missiles launched from temporarily occupied Crimea; Kh-31P anti-radar missiles launched from airspace over Black Sea. (Source: @kpszsu/71719)
Russian forces struck sea vessels involved in Ukrainian Armed Forces interests on evening of August 5. (Source: @tass_agency/388943)
Russian shadow fleet vessel Caffa used for illegal grain export from occupied Sevastopol; Swedish Supreme Court ordered transfer to Ukraine. (Source: @UkraineNow/83234)
Hvardiiske in temporarily occupied Crimea used as launch area for UAVs. (Source: @kpszsu/71719)
Odesa region under UAV threat from Black Sea direction. (Source: @kpszsu/71703)

Overnight Russian attack comprised 2 Oniks anti-ship missiles (launched from occupied Crimea), 2 Kh-31P anti-radar missiles (launched from Black Sea airspace), and 101 strike UAVs (mostly reactive Shahed, Gerbera, Italmas, parody drones) from Kursk, Millerovo, Orel, occupied Donetsk, and Hvardiiske (Crimea). (Source: @kpszsu/71719)

Ukrainian air defense (aviation, anti-aircraft missile troops, EW units, mobile fire groups) intercepted 66 UAVs; 29 strike UAVs and 1 Oniks missile hit 18 locations, debris at 5 locations; attack ongoing with several UAVs remaining. (Source: @kpszsu/71719)
